title: AI that assists the operation. Not the operator.
intro: AI capabilities are built on top of structured operational data, secure workflows and validated platform context. ISB AI is designed to reduce administrative friction and improve report structure while keeping responsibility with authorized personnel — not autonomous decisions.
principleBody: The operational sequence is field notes, structured extraction, an AI draft, officer review, supervisor approval, then a locked record. The explorer below is the working model. AI assists with structure only.
assistantTitle: Specific Report assistant · built on structured operational data.
assistantDescription: AI-assisted report drafting is in active development. Drafts require human review. AI does not make autonomous operational decisions.

controlItems.title: Officer review
controlItems.body: The officer reviews and corrects AI-assisted structure before submission.

controlItems.title: Supervisor approval
controlItems.body: Final operational acceptance remains with authorized supervisors.

controlItems.title: No autonomous decisions
controlItems.body: AI does not approve reports, classify incidents autonomously or replace escalation procedures.

controlItems.title: Traceable activity
controlItems.body: AI assistance is intended to remain visible within the operational record and review path.
